title: Windy Hill Sports Complex

services.name: Go Karts
services.desc: Windy Hill offers state-of-the-art Go Karts that operate on an exciting ¼ mile road course track. Karts are available for adults (58″ or taller) and youth (45″ to 57″) for timed 6 minute rides. Track is open year round with varying schedule depending on weather and time of the year. The Windy Hill Go Karts are weather-dependent, as we operate on an outdoor track. Any updates on conditions or closures will be posted here. Please call if you have questions or send us a message on
